text:
devin: quick heads-up — during the AWQ bakeoff on new-7b-v2 I'm seeing a recurring activation 'zipper' at layer 22 that correlates with ~0.8-1.0% delta on our eval set. anyone run into this pattern? :thinking:

maria: saw something similar last month on an OPT variant, seemed like a handful of channels with huge spikes and the rest quiet. we handled it with a per-channel clamp + selective fp16 fallback for that layer.

jon: can you paste a tiny plot or the histogram? if it's a few channels blowing up we can try channel-wise rescale or prune them from quantization.

devin: attaching quick stats: max activations in layer22 channels = [1.2, 0.02, 0.03, 0.01, 9.8, 0.04, ...] (top channel 9.8x bigger). eval BLEU dropped from 28.7 -> 27.9 after AWQ.

sara: sounds like classic outlier channels. options: 1) clamp those channels, 2) skip-quant layer22 entirely (keep fp16), 3) mixed-quant: AWQ except for top-k channels fp16, or 4) surgical median scaling per-channel.

alexa: +1 for trying mixed-quant first. skipping whole layer is blunt and raises perf cost. we have a small helper in repo for channel clamps: `tools/quant/channel_clamp.py`. example:```bash
python tools/quant/channel_clamp.py --model new-7b-v2 --layer 22 --topk 8 --scale 0.6
```

maria: I'll run three quick experiments: (A) clamp top-8 channels (scale=0.6), (B) keep top-8 channels fp16 and AWQ the rest, (C) fp16 fallback for entire layer22. will post eval numbers.

jon: also try `--adaptive-rescale` flag in that script, we've had wins on prompt-heavy evals. and add our eval set `squad-dev+prod-sample` for broader coverage.

devin: thanks. if (B) gets us within 0.1% of baseline with <2% perf hit it's the winner. can we capture token-latency for a 512-context run too?

ci-bot: started run 1999999999-zipper-probe on infra-cluster-7. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/1999999999 (will update artifacts). :rocket:

maria: results (summary): A clamp top-8 => BLEU 28.3 (delta -0.4), latency +0.5% ; B mixed-quant top-8 fp16 => BLEU 28.6 (delta -0.1), latency +1.8% ; C skip-layer fp16 => BLEU 28.7 (delta 0.0), latency +6.2%. full logs at artifact link.

devin: great — B looks best tradeoff. can you push a small quant profile that marks layer22 channels [indices listed] as fp16? include rollback policy to skip if perf > +3% on 512 context.

maria: will do. pushing PR in a bit with config patch and eval notebook. PR will include per-channel thresholds and a short note for ops on rollout.

jon: nice. longer-term we should add automated per-layer gating: detect zipper by kurtosis threshold and auto-mix-quant policy. filing a tracking ticket. :memo:

alexa: ping me for the rollout doc, I can help with wording and console metrics to watch (p50/p99 tokens, per-model cost delta).

ci-bot: run 1999999999-zipper-probe completed. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/1999999999/ (contains eval CSV and latency traces).

sara: great closure. assigning follow-ups: maria -> implement mixed-quant config (due in 48h), jon -> tracking ticket for auto-detect policy, alexa -> rollout checklist. closing thread after PR lands. :white_check_mark:
